title: Very nice candle with a very sweet tropical citrus fragrance when burned
text:
Very nice candle with a very sweet tropical citrus fragrance when burned. This has a nice citrus fragrance and is very attractive. Once burned, however, the tropical blend is a bit sweet, so it gave me a slight headache. If it burned as it smells when it is not burning, I would have rated this 4 stars.

On another note, mine arrived with a slightly bent container as you can see in the lower right-hand corner and I suspect that was because it was shipped in a padded envelope.
